question: P is the brother of Q and the son of T. S is the wife of T and the mother-in-law of R. If T and S have only 2 children, a son and a daughter, then how is Q related to S?
solution:
By using the symbols in the table given below, we can draw the following family tree:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68649cacfa98245f0ceb36f716a73c5c632a9f59d024076540dec2107071feb2.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6c097cfba42cd680645695f81c7f32d0cb160c751369b1b0ab7277f9383b9aa.png] 

Clearly, Q is daughter of S.

Hence, ‘**Daughter**’ is the correct answer.
